description: Implementation of a metrics provider class for 5G network performance monitoring, including metric registration, data reporting, and retrieval functions for various network metrics such as CQI, RSRP, RSRQ, PRB availability, throughput, latency, and packet drop rates.

classes.name: e2sm_kpm_du_meas_provider_impl
classes.description: Class implementing network measurement data collection and retrieval for 5G network elements, supporting various metrics and test conditions.

methods.name: check_e2sm_kpm_metrics_definitions
methods.description: Validates that supported metrics match external metric definitions.

methods.name: report_metrics
methods.description: Stores scheduler and RLC metrics data for later retrieval.

methods.name: clear_rlc_metrics
methods.description: Removes outdated RLC metrics based on time interval.

methods.name: get_supported_metric_names
methods.description: Returns list of metric names supported at specified level.

methods.name: is_cell_supported
methods.description: Placeholder for cell support check.

methods.name: is_ue_supported
methods.description: Placeholder for UE support check.

methods.name: is_test_cond_supported
methods.description: Placeholder for test condition support check.

methods.name: is_metric_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific metric with given label, level, and scope is supported.

methods.name: get_ues_matching_test_conditions
methods.description: Retrieves UEs matching specified test conditions (currently returns all).

methods.name: get_meas_data
methods.description: Retrieves measurement data for specified metric and UEs.

methods.name: handle_no_meas_data_available
methods.description: Fills measurement items with default values when no data is available.

methods.name: get_cqi
methods.description: Retrieves CQI measurement for UEs.

methods.name: get_rsrp
methods.description: Retrieves RSRP measurement for UEs.

methods.name: get_rsrq
methods.description: Retrieves RSRQ measurement for UEs.

methods.name: get_prb_avail_dl
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink PRB availability.

methods.name: get_prb_avail_ul
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink PRB availability.

methods.name: get_prb_used_dl
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink PRB usage.

methods.name: get_prb_used_ul
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink PRB usage.

methods.name: get_prb_use_perc_dl
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink PRB usage percentage.

methods.name: get_prb_use_perc_ul
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink PRB usage percentage.

methods.name: get_drb_dl_mean_throughput
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink throughput.

methods.name: get_drb_ul_mean_throughput
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink throughput.

methods.name: get_drb_rlc_packet_drop_rate_dl
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink RLC packet drop rate.

methods.name: get_drb_rlc_sdu_transmitted_volume_dl
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink RLC SDU transmitted volume.

methods.name: get_drb_rlc_sdu_transmitted_volume_ul
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink RLC SDU transmitted volume.

methods.name: get_drb_dl_rlc_sdu_latency
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink RLC SDU latency.

methods.name: get_drb_ul_rlc_sdu_latency
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink RLC SDU latency.

methods.name: get_delay_ul
methods.description: Retrieves uplink delay.

methods.name: get_prach_cell_count
methods.description: Retrieves count of preamble dedications per cell.
